related_questions.question: What are the guidelines when you test positive for COVID?
related_questions.snippet: If your COVID-19 test is positive Monitor your symptoms. If you have any emergency warning signs, seek emergency care immediately. Seek health care right away for treatment if you have risk factors for severe illness. Treatment may be an option to make your symptoms less severe and shorten the time you are sick.

related_questions.question: Do you still have to quarantine if exposed to someone with COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: If you've been exposed to COVID-19, you should monitor for symptoms for 14 days and get tested if you develop any symptoms. If you don't develop symptoms, you will need to stay in self-quarantine for 10 days from the last time you were in close contact with the infected person. You can end quarantine if you remain symptom-free, have no further contact with someone with COVID-19, and the infected person has completed their self-isolation.
